description: This file contains unit tests for safe read operations on file handles in Swift, specifically testing reading to end and reading up to a certain count from pipes, including handling of closed handles.

classes.name: FileHandleSafeReadTests
classes.description: A struct encapsulating multiple test functions for verifying safe reading behavior on file handles.

methods.name: read to end safely returns empty for closed handle
methods.description: Tests that reading to the end from a closed handle results in empty data.

methods.name: read safely up to count returns empty for closed handle
methods.description: Tests that attempting to read up to a count from a closed handle results in empty data.

methods.name: read to end safely reads pipe contents
methods.description: Verifies that reading to the end from a pipe handle retrieves the written data.

methods.name: read safely up to count reads incrementally
methods.description: Checks that reading with a specified count retrieves data in increments correctly.
